sections.lede: CleanJibe reads your session off the watch. It tells you your time on the foil, every flight, your speed records, and a verdict on every turn. Flew through, touchdown, or fell in.
sections.note: It is free and needs no account. The example opens right here in your browser.
sections.title: Did you fly through that jibe?

sections.lede: CleanJibe shows your time on the foil, every flight and every touchdown. Each jibe gets a verdict: flew through, touchdown, or fell in. You see your dry streak and your fastest seconds. The replay comes with a commentary.
sections.title: Your WingFoil session, measured.

sections.lede: A real 10-minute session on Lake Garda.
sections.note: Every session gives you a card like this to share.
sections.title: Try the example session

items.detail: How much of your session you spent flying rather than just moving.
One takeoff starts a flight. A touchdown or a fall ends it. Both are counted.
How many jibes in a row you stayed out of the water, and the best run of the day.
Your fastest 2 seconds, 10 seconds, 500 m and nautical mile. The speedsurfing world uses the same windows.
The turn kept the foil, from the sweep until you were flying again.
Your board touched the water and you got going again without falling in. A stop under 5 s counts as a touchdown. Longer, and it counts as a fall.
Every time you ended up in the water, in a turn or in a straight line.
A jibe that flew through, held 70 % of its entry speed, and stayed quiet for 10 s.
It records on your wrist, with live numbers and a summary when you save.
It reads every session from Garmin, Strava and other watches, judges every turn and keeps your library.
Most of the same analysis in a browser tab. Drop a file in or import from intervals.icu, with no account.
It records your session on the wrist. The analysis happens on the iPhone.

sections.lede: CleanJibe is a family of apps on one analysis engine.
sections.title: The CleanJibe family

items.detail: You get everything. Add the watch app for a verdict on your wrist after every jibe.
The browser app works on Android and on any computer. Your sessions stay in that browser.
The watch app comes with the iPhone app. Apple's own Workout app works too, through Apple Health.
Strava comes in on the iPhone. A .fit file works in both apps.

sections.note: The iPhone app installs through Apple's TestFlight app. It is free, and there is no invite to wait for.
sections.title: Which way in is yours?

items.detail: Windsurf, SUP, Kitesurf or Surfing all count. So does any activity you named wing or foil.
Garmin has no open API, so the free intervals.icu is the bridge. Two years of sessions come across.
Drop a .fit, .gpx or .tcx into the browser app. It is read on your device and never uploaded.
items.term: Or one file at a time

sections.lede: Your last season is already on your watch account. Connect it once and CleanJibe reads every session you rode.
sections.title: Bring in the sessions you already have

items.detail: The watch buzzes after every jibe, so you know how it went before you look.
It records your wrist as well, so every pump stroke and every takeoff attempt is counted.
Foil time, flights and your dry streak while you ride. A summary comes up when you save.

sections.lede: The free CleanJibe app for Garmin records a wingfoil session the way we read one.
sections.note: It runs on {garmin-count} Garmin watches, from the fenix 8 down to the vívoactive.
sections.title: Get much more with the watch app

actions.title: Tell us what you want next

items.detail: You sign up for nothing, here or in the apps.
Your sessions stay on your phone or in your browser. We only see one if you send it to us.
The engine is on GitHub. Every threshold behind a verdict can be read there.
We build CleanJibe and we wingfoil. Tell us which verdict looked wrong, or what you want next.

sections.lede: CleanJibe is built with its riders. New features land in the beta first, and move to the App Store once testers have proven them.
Join the beta or send ideas via Menu → Support & ideas.
sections.note: Send ideas via Menu → Support & ideas.
